text_block_list.name: Party Host
text_block_list.text:
Why, if it isn't the young ladies of the 
Mejiro family. Thank you for attending 
despite your busy schedules.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The pleasure is ours. We are truly honored 
by your invitation, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
(A gathering where racing figures come 
together to exchange views... As a member 
of the Mejiro family, I must conduct 
myself with utmost propriety.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
You're releasing a new home gym machine 
soon, right?! I'm really looking forward 
to that specialized lat pulldown—

text_block_list.name: Racing Official
text_block_list.text:
I recently toured Europe, you see. The 
turf courses over there really are quite 
different from ours... Not just in 
heaviness, but in terrain and turf texture 
as well—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Yet one cannot afford to let one's heart 
be completely captivated by the turf 
alone.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
—One must become stronger, more supple. 
For that sacred battleground has woven its 
history through such enduring excellence.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
(Ryan's vast knowledge of training...! I 
am nowhere near ready to join in on that 
conversation...)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
(And—Ramonu-san's profound insight... Her 
voracious passion for racing is truly 
overwhelming—)

text_block_list.name: Racing Official
text_block_list.text:
—Oh yes, I am hosting a ball in the near 
future. Would you care to attend?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —...Phew.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Please direct matters of that sort to this 
child. Now then... if you will excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ramonu-san?! —Ah!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Um, please forgive the interruption. 
You mentioned a ball, was it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
If someone like myself would suffice, I 
would be delighted to accept your 
invitation, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Racing Official
text_block_list.text:
My, how wonderful! I shall eagerly look 
forward to sharing a dance with you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
—And that is what occurred... so I ended 
up accepting the invitation in her stead.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah~ ahaha. That sounds just like 
Ramonu-san. So McQueen, you're going all 
by yourself?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes, since the invitation provided was 
only for one person...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I shall view this as a splendid 
opportunity and fulfill my duties 
admirably as a member of the Mejiro 
family, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I see. Yeah, I'm sure you'll do 
great, McQueen. Good luck!

Taking a break from work to get some fresh 
air, I stepped outside and—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Before the day of the ball, I need dance 
lessons, reviewing the guest list... and 
deciding on what attire to wear—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Phew, the tasks are piling up into quite a 
mountain, desu wa...
choice_data_list: You seem pretty busy, are you alright?
You look quite busy, is everything okay?

When you're tired, sweet treats work 
wonders!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Phew, the tasks are piling up into quite a 
mountain, desu wa...
choice_data_list: You seem pretty busy, are you alright?
You look quite busy, is everything okay?

When you're tired, sweet treats work 
wonders!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oh... no, there is no need for concern.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
As a daughter of the Mejiro family, I must 
carry out my duty. This hardly even counts 
as being busy, desu wa.

Since I happened to have an extra hot 
cocoa that I bought by mistake from the 
vending machine, I offered it to her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: My goodness...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
—. As you say, a moderate intake of sugar 
is vital, isn't it? I shall gladly accept, 
desu wa.
